title: Word stress in long words
what: stressing the wrong syllable in long or related words ('deVElopment' right, 'DEvelopment' wrong; 'PHOtograph', 'phoTOgraphy', 'photoGRAphic')
summary: Misplaced word stress often persists because learners don't perceive it as an error. This can make speech sound unnatural, requiring listeners to exert more effort to process the intended meaning.
listenFor: Pay close attention to which syllable you emphasize in longer words, especially when they are related to other words with different stress patterns.
drills: The comprehensive analysis of the economic data revealed significant developmental opportunities.
Effective communication is fundamental for successful organizational collaboration and innovation.
Her academic achievements demonstrated exceptional analytical capabilities and intellectual curiosity.
We discussed the political implications of the new environmental regulations and their potential impact.
The comfortable accommodations provided a relaxing environment after the intensive educational seminar.
He documented the architectural details with meticulous photography, capturing every intricate element.
Prioritizing sustainable development is crucial for the long-term economic stability of the region.
The university's educational programs emphasize practical application and critical thinking development.
Responsible financial management is essential for the stability and growth of any organization.
The committee's recommendation for a comprehensive evaluation received unanimous approval.

probes.sentence: The organizational development plan requires careful consideration and strategic implementation.
Her academic background in economics provided a unique perspective on global financial markets.
The comfortable environment facilitated productive discussions during the international conference.
He presented a detailed photographic exhibition showcasing the cultural diversity of the continent.

stress.marked: The deVElopment of the PROject was SLOW.
stress.note: Main stress on the second syllable of 'development'.
Main stress on the fourth syllable of 'organization'.
Main stress on the third syllable of 'academic'.
Main stress on the third syllable of 'economic'.
Main stress on the second syllable of 'comfortable'.
Main stress on the second syllable of 'photography'.
